# Tests not enabled in the current syscall-conformance profile.
testcases/kernel/syscalls/abort/abort01.c not yet enabled in current syscall-conformance profile
testcases/kernel/syscalls/accept/accept01.c requires accept(2) EBADF/EINVAL/EOPNOTSUPP error-matrix coverage and queued AF_INET listener behavior beyond the current accept4-backed socket subset
testcases/kernel/syscalls/accept/accept02.c CVE multicast membership clone test requires SOL_IP MCAST_JOIN_GROUP/MCAST_LEAVE_GROUP and checkpointed threaded AF_INET accept behavior outside the current socket option subset
testcases/kernel/syscalls/accept/accept03.c requires differentiating EBADF for O_PATH/open_tree fds from ENOTSOCK for other non-socket fds; current socket fd lookup collapses these cases
testcases/kernel/syscalls/accept4/accept4_01.c direct accept4 semantics are implemented and covered by Rust contract; upstream LTP also requires AF_INET loopback connect scheduling in the kernel-only runner and a legacy socketcall(SYS_ACCEPT4) variant absent from the RISC-V syscall ABI

testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitid/waitid10.c requires signal/core-dump accounting for SIGFPE plus setup dependencies on RLIMIT_CORE, `/proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern`, and `prctl(2)`/core-dump policy; current waitid conform surface does not claim `CLD_DUMPED` or core-pattern behavior
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid01.c setup requires getrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE) inside a saved LTP child; current resource syscall returns ESRCH in that context before the waitpid signal matrix runs
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid06.c passes targeted validation, but the full LTP gate currently causes later writev rows to run out of memory after checkpointed waitpid child-fanout snapshot allocation
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid07.c WNOHANG child-fanout release ordering does not complete in the current saved-runner scheduling; strict local run leaves children under an intermediate parent and does not reach final LTP evidence
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid08.c requires stopped-child waitpid state (`WUNTRACED`, `WIFSTOPPED`, `WSTOPSIG(SIGSTOP)`) and SIGCONT continuation; current waitpid conform surface covers exited/signaled child state only

testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_wait/epoll_wait06.c local EPOLLET pipe edge-trigger contract now passes in kernel tests, but the upstream LTP binary still exits 2 without diagnostics, so the remaining blocker is LTP-specific harness/integration behavior
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_wait/epoll_wait05.c local `shutdown(SHUT_RD)` / `EPOLLRDHUP` gate now passes on injected connected sockets, but the upstream LTP binary still exits 2 on the real bind/listen/connect socket path, so the remaining blocker is socket network integration behavior rather than bare epoll event decoding
testcases/kernel/syscalls/setuid/setuid04.c requires filesystem access checks to reject non-owner write opens after setuid; current filesystem permission path allows this LTP open
